username.alreadyExists: An account with this username already exists.

email.verification: Enter your new email address. We will send an approval link to your current address before applying the change.
email.same: You are already using this email address.
email.taken: An account already uses this email address.
email.currentNotVerified: Verify your current email address before changing it.
email.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again and retry.
email.cooldown: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
email.sendFailed: We could not start the email change. Please try again.

manageAccount.title: Manage Account
manageAccount.resetPasswordDialog: We'll send you an email with a link which you can use to create a new password for your account.
manageAccount.deleteAccountDialog: Please confirm the deletion of your account by typing the following into the field:
manageAccount.irreversibleAction: Please remember that this action is irreversible.

bugReporting.title: Bug Reporting
bugReporting.bugReportingModeDescription: Help us find and fix bugs. Bug Reporting Mode activates a small widget in the bottom corner of your screen which you can click to copy console logs.

user.title: User
user.description: Manage your NexoChess identity and account security.
user.usernameUpdateFailed: The username could not be updated.
user.usernameDialog: Choose the username shown on your NexoChess account.

guest.title: You are using NexoChess as a guest
guest.description: Your analysed games remain available in the local Archive on this device. Sign in from the top-right menu to manage an email address, password, username and optional date of birth.

dateOfBirthDialog.description: Optional. This information stays private and can be removed at any time.
dateOfBirthDialog.invalid: Enter a valid date between 1900 and today.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently remove your account and its cloud archive. Games stored only on this device are not affected.
delete.confirm: Type {{username}} to confirm permanent account deletion.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used across the NexoChess interface and account emails.

boardTheme.title: Board theme
boardTheme.description: Choose a board palette. Event and sponsored themes are intentionally excluded.

pieces.title: Piece set
pieces.description: Select a standard piece family. Event and sponsor sets are excluded.
pieces.note: Chess.com's Neo artwork is not bundled because it is proprietary; these are standard open alternatives.

coordinates.title: Coordinates
coordinates.description: Choose whether board coordinates are drawn inside or outside the board.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Your selected board and pieces are previewed together below.

coach.title: Coach
coach.description: Control whether your coach appears and animates during game analysis.

enabled.title: Enable coach
enabled.description: Show the selected coach and its comments in Game Summary and Review.

animations.title: Coach animations
animations.description: Allow blinking and mouth movement. Turn this off to use a static portrait.

privacySection.title: Privacy
privacySection.description: Control data stored by NexoChess on this browser and review the policies that apply to your account.

preferences.title: Data preferences
preferences.description: Review optional consent choices used by the site. Essential storage required for settings, authentication and your local archive is not disabled here.

archive.title: Local game archive
archive.description: Guest analyses are saved only in this browser. Clearing browser data or using the button below permanently removes those local games.
archive.cleared: The local archive on this device has been cleared.
archive.confirm: Delete every game saved locally on this device? This cannot be undone.
